name: censusing-formation-doctrine
description: Use when census the entire source territory named by a formation question before compressing it into curriculum.
preconditions: the exact customer, candidate, source, or Academy record in scope resolves
the acting office's authority and refusal boundary are explicit
required evidence is available or its absence is recorded
postconditions: one replayable doctrine census with omissions counted rather than hidden
no customer appointment, capability grant, or cross-settlement write is performed

records: one replayable doctrine census with omissions counted rather than hidden
